violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. PIC was not able to provide a Certified Food Manager certification at the time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Please obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program prior to follow-up inspection. The follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The hot water faucet valves at the handwashing sinks in the kitchen and bar are broken, and not hot water is available.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. Please ensure the availability of hot water at both handwashing sinks at a minimum of 100F prior to the follow-up inspection. The follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Opening to the exterior of the building is present along the delivery door at the back of kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Please install a protective gasket on the delivery door at the back of the kitchen prior to the follow-up inspection. The follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The hot water faucet valves at the handwashing sinks in the kitchen and bar are broken, and not hot water is available.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Please repair the valves to ensure hot water availability at 100F of above prior to follow-up inspection. The follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. Please install the covered feminine napkin refuse container in the ladies room prior to following-up inspection. The follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: squeeze bottles of salt, sugar, olive oil and bulk rice container.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC labeled all squeeze bottles of salt, sugar, olive oil and bulk rice container.
